name: Digital Samba
description: Digital Samba. Read from the sources on 2026-11-16: digitalsamba.com CSS (Inter, headings 600 in sentence case, ink #222326, secondary #6a6d77, blue #3771e0 for links and buttons, hairline #e3e6ec, tint #f8f9fb, radii 4/8/12), the logo (react-account-center/public/logo.svg: a coral mark, 'digital' in navy #323E66, 'samba' in coral #F06859) and the app theme (theme-provider.js: primary #3771e0). Blue is the product and the site; navy and coral are the logo's. Coral is used sparingly outside the logo. Orange is not a DS colour.

fonts.primary: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.note: digitalsamba.com sets Inter at 400 and 600; headings are 600, sentence case, no tight tracking. The app (my.digitalsamba.com) uses the system UI stack, so rebuilt screens keep that.

assets.note: ds-logo.svg is the app's own (react-account-center/public/logo.svg). On navy use logoOnDark (wordmark white, coral kept); on blue use logoWhite; the coral mark never sits on blue.

fields.note: For templates that colour by act (howto): the dark field is the logo's navy, secondary text is the site's grey, and the grounds are flat (no rows).
